evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The current `manager_restarted` check only requires nonzero, different manager PIDs and nonempty, different invocation IDs. A guest reboot changes both of those, so it can satisfy `manager_restarted`; the later reboot check can still be satisfied by a subsequent reboot. Requiring nonempty equal guest boot IDs on the manager before/after snapshots is the smallest compatible fix and prevents reboot evidence from being counted as a manager restart.
